title: Settled navigation stays stable; it grows consistently and only significant redesigns come up for PR (2026-10-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Lets record the old structure, and then record what changed to make it better. 
Once a repo has a settled navigation, it should not completely rearrange itself, but musrs has no working structure so any change is an improvement. 

Navigation should make it possible for a human to find and navigate the content of a repo. As a repo grows, it should evolve in a consistent manner automatically, with only significant redesigns coming up for PR.
